objectives.statement: Distinguish synes, tror, and mener for subjective reactions, uncertain beliefs, and considered opinions.
Distinguish vite, kjenne, and kunne for facts, familiarity, and skills or languages.
Diagnose common English-to-Norwegian know and think traps in short sentences.

notes: Must contrast opinion/belief verbs (synes for subjective feeling, tro for belief/uncertainty, mene for considered opinion) and knowing verbs (vite for factual knowledge, kjenne for familiarity with people/places, kunne for ability/knowing a skill or language). Include the English know mapping traps (know a fact vs know a person vs know how).
